verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents a CLI (`pd deploy`, `pd dev`) for building custom components from local code. `pd dev` links a local file to a deployed component and live-updates it, so developers can create their own event sources. It also offers source-available components with a GitHub PR path for new components, plus TypeScript, Python and Java SDKs and a REST API. missing for 10: documentation of the component authoring API (props, custom app auth definitions), explicit evidence of private custom actions as opposed to sources, independent hands-on corroboration of building custom connectors.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a custom connector or private integration with a documented developer platform, SDK, or CLI

citations.quote: pd dev` allows you to interactively develop a source from a local file.`pd dev` will link your local file with the deployed component and watch your local file for changes.
Deploy an event source from local or remote code.
You can also create a PR to contribute new components via GitHub.
Pipedream provides TypeScript, Python, and Java SDKs along with a REST API to interact with the Connect service.
